deathSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Chen Koenig. Crossing guard. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Unnamed photograph, Dead Phone, Seed packet, Photo album, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong. They move when you aren't looking. Yesterday there were seven. Tonight there are nine. They're getting closer.

🔥 The fire settles. Mara has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A crow that watches too long and blinks too little — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Carmine says "So it bleeds." Ursula mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
